visual_action: The video is a montage of shots of a restaurant called 'Charcoal Pit'. It shows the exterior signs, the interior with classic diner-style booths, a menu of ice cream flavors, and framed photos on the wall. A still photo is shown of Joe Biden sitting in a booth with a family. The video ends with a wide shot of the area, showing a river and buildings, with a location pin identifying the restaurant in Wilmington, DE.
